{{Top|leg}}
'''Blue Deck''' was a deck on [[Sel Zonn Station]].

==Description==
Blue Deck was reserved for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel and so was very clean and well maintained, unlike the rest of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The insignia of the Empire could be found all over the deck, along with posters of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The entrances and exits to it were guarded by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

==History==
[[Skig Banos]], an Imperial informant, lived on the deck. After he was hired by [[Alderaanian Security]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Switch]] arranged for one of their agents, who had been frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], to be stored on the deck, in it's main cargo bay. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for the Alderaanians went there to collect it.
